abort.nothing_to_migrate: There is no standard Risco integration to copy from.

menu_options.migrate: Copy from the standard Risco integration (recommended)

migrate.title: Copy from Risco
migrate.description: Account and options are copied. At the first start the standard Risco integration is disabled (not deleted) and Risco Plus keeps the same entity names, so dashboards and automations keep working. You can delete the old integration afterwards.

not_local_entry.message: This service only works with local Risco connections.

panel_busy.message: The panel is busy (Risco Cloud result 52): try again in a few seconds

invalid_code.message: Wrong code: the alarm was not changed

ha_to_risco.description: Choose what each Home Assistant mode arms on the Risco panel: full, partial, one group or several groups together (e.g. Night = groups B + C).
ha_to_risco.title: Home Assistant modes → Risco

data.concurrency: Maximum concurrent requests in Risco local
data.scan_interval: How often to poll Risco Cloud (in seconds)

extra_options.name: Risco Plus
extra_options.description: Extra functions. Leave empty to keep the standard behaviour.

data.custom_code: Code for arming/disarming from Home Assistant
data.group_names: Group names (one line per group, e.g. "B: Balconies")
data.group_entities: Create an entity for every group (armed sensor and arm button)
data.open_zones_mode: When zones are open at arming
data.read_from_cloud_cache: Read state from the Risco Cloud copy (for old IP modules)

data_description.custom_code: If set, only this code works (instead of the integration PIN) and it is always required to disarm.
data_description.group_names: Shown on the card and in the group entities. Groups without a name keep their letter.
data_description.group_entities: For each partition: "Group B armed" sensors and "Arm group B" buttons, handy for automations and voice assistants.
data_description.open_zones_mode: What to do when a zone is open while arming from Home Assistant (card, alarm panel, automations, voice).
data_description.perimeter_zones: Used only by the last two choices above. Not needed for "Don't arm and notify, if a zone of the groups...": every zone is checked.
data_description.read_from_cloud_cache: Home Assistant stops querying the panel on every update. Use it if the iRISCO app shows connection errors while Home Assistant is running.

zone_groups_section.name: Zones of each group
zone_groups_section.description: With Risco Cloud the panel usually doesn't say which groups a zone belongs to: choose them here so only the zones of the groups being armed are checked. A zone not listed counts for every group. Not needed with the local connection.

data.zone_groups: Zones of each group, as text (older way)

data_description.zone_groups: One line per zone, e.g. "Kitchen window: BC". The lists above are easier.

risco_to_ha.description: Choose which state Home Assistant shows for each state reported by the Risco panel. When several groups are armed, a mode mapped to exactly those groups (next step) is shown instead.
risco_to_ha.title: Risco states → Home Assistant states

set_time.description: Sets the time of an alarm panel.

config_entry_id.description: The Risco alarm panel to set the time for.
config_entry_id.name: Config entry

time.description: The time to send to the alarm panel. Leave it empty to use the Home Assistant system time.
time.name: Time

set_time.name: Set the alarm panel time

arm_groups.name: Arm groups
arm_groups.description: Arms one or more Risco groups at once.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: The groups to arm (A, B, C, D).

code.name: Code
code.description: Needed only if "Require PIN to arm" is enabled.

options.block: Don't arm and notify, if a zone of the groups being armed is open
options.block_selected: Don't arm and notify, only for the zones chosen below
options.bypass: Bypass the open zones and arm (the zones chosen below still block)
